CATEGORY: 过 for experience (Coherence: temporality)
definition: Use 过 to mean “have done/have experienced.” Do not use it when the stated experience has not happened yet.

HER NOTES IN THIS CATEGORY (3 distinct):
1 | “过” for “have done, experience”
1 | “过” experience, have done, Place到处都 + Clause
1 | it is loosely connected with the previous sentence, better add “为了帮助人们找到能吃的植物”, 神农决定去旅行尝试新的植物，“过” is to express “experience”, now the experience has not yet been experienced

HER CORRECTIONS (5 of 5):
[mengmu_samples#22/f5/p0/k0/e0] 他跟很多人[打交道→打过交道]  || her note: “过” for “have done, experience”
[mengmu_samples#50/f11/p0/k0/e0] 他们[在到处的中国住→在中国各地都住过]  || her note: “过” experience, have done, Place到处都 + Clause
[shennong_samples#1/f2/p0/note/e1] [神农旅行了，吃过新的植物→神农决定去旅行尝试新的植物]  || her note: it is loosely connected with the previous sentence, better add “为了帮助人们找到能吃的植物”, 神农决定去旅行尝试新的植物，“过” is to express “experience”, now the experience has not yet been experienced
[mengmu_samples#49/f6/p1/k0/e0] 原来他的父母都[没做过而祭拜→没祭拜过]
[mengmu_samples#49/f7/p0/k0/e1] 他认为没做过[祭拜的→祭拜过的]孩子的父母老是死了

output.rule: Use 过 to mean “have done” or “have experienced” something. Do not use 过 when the action or experience has not happened yet.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/experience> has happened before, so use 过 to show “have done/have experienced”; if it has not happened yet, do not use 过.

examples.explanation: 打交道 → 打过交道: He has had this experience before, so use 过 for “have done/experienced.”
在到处的中国住 → 在中国各地都住过: Living in places across China is past experience, so use 住过; use Place到处都 + Clause.
神农旅行了，吃过新的植物 → 神农决定去旅行尝试新的植物: The experience has not happened yet—he only decides to travel and try new plants—so do not use 过.
没做过而祭拜 → 没祭拜过: Not worshipping is an experience/action that has not happened before, so put 过 after 祭拜.

output.not_an_error: Do not flag a sentence for missing 过 if it is about a future or not-yet-happened action; 过 cannot describe an experience that has not yet been experienced.
